t: Most people use Claude like a chatbot, the people getting ahead hand it real work and get finished files back.
You shift from typist to director, like a film director, describe what the scene needs,
then review and steer the AI's translation, not operate the camera.
In this course, you'll set up projects, create artifacts you can share, teach Claude your way with skills,
plug in your tools and plugins, and put agents and automations to work.
Ten short lessons and ten hands-on missions. For new hires, people leveling up and anyone going after a new job.
Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani. Start with Lesson One at LetsVibeAI.com. Learn, build, ship.
